quotations.old_english: Gif se earm biþ forad búfan elmbogan if the arm be broken above the elbow

source_text: elm-boga, an; m. An elbow; c&u-short;b&i-short;tum :-- Gif se earm biþ forad búfan elmbogan if the arm be broken above the elbow, L. Alf. pol. 54; Th. i. 94, 24. v. el-boga.
